outcome.description: sent: Gmail took this mail for sending — by its answer, or, when the answer was lost, because Gmail no longer holds the draft the send was made from

message_id.description: the sent message's id in Gmail; empty when Gmail's answer to the send was lost and the draft's absence is all that shows it left

labels.description: its labels as Gmail holds them: SENT once it is sent

message_id_header.description: the Message-ID Gmail wrote for it, as read back

confirmed.description: whether a read shows it in Sent; false when that read failed, which proves nothing either way

confirmation.description: what the reads showed, or why they could not

delivery.description: what the receipt does not say: that anyone received, read or accepted the mail
